source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-20

procedures.title: Distributor contact points: replace (V8)
steps: The point set is replaced as a complete unit; spring tension and alignment are factory set, so only dwell needs adjusting afterward.
Remove the cap: push a screwdriver into the latch slot, press down and turn 1/4 turn either way.
Remove the 2 screws holding the base of the contact set.
Unhook the primary and condenser leads from the nylon-insulated connection in the contact set (see figure 6i in the manual).
Install the new set by reversing these steps, routing the primary and condenser leads exactly as in figure 6i; wrong routing lets the leads foul the cap, weight base and breaker advance plate.

At 20,000 to 25,000 miles (or sooner), replace the cam lubricator wick: squeeze it together at the base with long-nose pliers and lift it out, wipe all old lubricant off the cam, and fit the new one the same way.
Set the wick end to just touch the cam lobes; pressing too hard over-greases the cam and gets grease on the points. Do not add grease to the cam.
Start the engine and check dwell and ignition timing.
notes: Never oil the cam lubricator; replace the wick when necessary, square to the cam and just touching the lobe (figure 7i).
